text:
maria (releases): cutting RC candidate now. artifact sha=abc1234. requesting a 2h pin and a 30m quiet window for post-promo checks.

deploy-bot: build succeeded — artifact: gcr.io/redwood/serve:rc-abc1234 (size 1.2GB). preflight checks green.

jamie (qa): quick smoke on staging passed. saw a small median bump (~50ms) in embed-service during KV warm step. re-ran reranks, one flaky test, re-ran and passed.

leo (oncall): canary plan looks good. propose traffic shifts: 5% -> 25% -> 50% with 10m holds. I'll watch metrics.

dan (sheriff): rollback criteria proposal: if p95 latency > 300ms for 3 consecutive mins OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, initiate rollback. Also abort on OOM spikes.

maria (releases): adding rollback criteria to the promo ticket and pinning artifact. link: https://t.releases/RC-abc1234 (note: internal)

deploy-bot: promo preflight: KV cache warm=86%, batch size avg=4, GPU mem headroom ok, no OOMs in last 1h.

jamie (qa): observed one tail latency spike in rerank at +2m, but not reproducible. :white_check_mark: after re-run.

dan (sheriff): ack. I'll be watching p95 and error rate. ping me @channel for anomalies.

maria (releases): promoting to prod in 5m. I'll post the promote command here.

maria (releases): final promote command:
```
deploybot promote --artifact gcr.io/redwood/serve:rc-abc1234 --pin 2h --canary 5,25,50 --hold 10m --rollback "p95>300ms:3m"
```

deploy-bot: promotion started. canary id cb-20260321-01. initial traffic 5% routed to canary.

leo (oncall): watching latency, kv-hit ratios, and CPU.

jamie (qa): canary at 5% — no increase in 5xxs, error_rate ~0.12%.

dan (sheriff): seeing a small p95 blip at +7m, investigating logs for embed-worker.

maria (releases): noticed embed-worker OOM trace in logs around +7m, spinning up an extra pod pool to alleviate pressure; pausing further scheduled shifts until stabilized.

deploy-bot: auto-shift paused due to manual hold by maria (releases).

leo (oncall): after scaling up pod pool, p95 returned to baseline. recommend resuming to 25% and hold 15m.

dan (sheriff): agree — resume cautiously. if another p95 violation happens, rollback immediately.

maria (releases): resuming. shifting to 25% now.

deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 25% — canary still healthy.

jamie (qa): telemetry looks stable: latency and error rate within thresholds. :rocket:

maria (releases): completing promo. will keep the 2h pin for post-deploy monitoring, then remove if green. release notes draft: "RC abc1234 promoted to prod. Canary tests passed after scale-up. Rollback thresholds: p95>300ms for 3m or error_rate>0.5%."

deploy-bot: promotion finished at ts=7250004402. canary id cb-20260321-01 -> promoted.

dan (sheriff): nice work team — closing watch. I'll file a short postmortem if we see any noisy regressions. :thumbsup:
